item.title: New Republic library opens to the public
item.description: The new and expanded Republic Branch Library opened Monday morning after around a year of construction, featuring double the size of the old branch, a Business Connect Center, a 150-seat community room, a walking path and a Maker Space, with funding coming from the American Rescue Plan Act (ARPA), donations and library reserves.

item.title: A little hiccup in the thaw before we get to our warmest weekend in weeks
item.description: After a cold start to the week, temperatures will rise to the 50s by Thursday and remain mild through the weekend.

item.title: Pancheros set to open new location in Springfield
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — Pancheros Mexican Grill, the Iowa-based restaurant chain, will officially open its sixth location in Missouri on Tuesday, February 3, in Springfield, MO, with plans to continue expanding throughout the state. The new location, opening on 2100 W Republic Road, will join three Columbia locations, one in Jefferson City and another in Rolla. [...]

item.title: Missing woman from Eldon found dead after vehicle crash
